Post: I Left Church but Not God
PostSummary: Long posts from longtime churchgoers explain that they have stopped attending while insisting their faith is intact — church, they say, was the problem, not God.
BiblicalResponse: It is possible to love God while being wounded by His people, and no honest answer pretends otherwise. But the New Testament never pictures faith as a solo project: the church is Christ's body, and we need its teaching, correction, encouragement, and communion — even when it is imperfect, because it always will be. If you have stepped away, consider a gentle return: a different congregation, a small group, a first step back toward the people Jesus gave you.
